description: This bar chart, titled “better,” displays the task count for three categories—“mBERT,” “XLM-R,” and “same”—across nine different language families or groups: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The horizontal axis lists these nine categories in alphabetical order, while the vertical axis, labeled “task count,” ranges from 0 to 40 in increments of 10, using a linear scale. Each category has three bars stacked vertically: a light blue bar representing “mBERT,” a dark blue bar representing “XLM-R,” and a light green bar representing “same.” The heights of the bars indicate the task count for each model/category combination. For IE-Baltic, the task counts are approximately 10 for mBERT, 10 for XLM-R, and 8 for same. For IE-Germanic, the counts are approximately 4 for mBERT, 18 for XLM-R, and 22 for same. For IE-Indic, the counts are approximately 1 for mBERT, 5 for XLM-R, and 4 for same. For IE-Romance, the counts are approximately 4 for mBERT, 13 for XLM-R, and 30 for same. For IE-Slavic, the counts are approximately 12 for mBERT, 39 for XLM-R, and 28 for same. For IE-other, the counts are approximately 1 for mBERT, 7 for XLM-R, and 8 for same. For Isolate, the counts are approximately 1 for mBERT, 5 for XLM-R, and 1 for same. For Semitic, the counts are approximately 1 for mBERT, 7 for XLM-R, and 1 for same. For Uralic, the counts are approximately 1 for mBERT, 14 for XLM-R, and 5 for same. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the categories on the horizontal axis. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding according to the legend.
